items.stem: Show that the relation R on Z defined by R = {(a, b) : a − b is divisible by 4} is an equivalence relation.

items.stem: Show that the relation R on Z defined by R = {(a, b) : a − b is divisible by 2} is an equivalence relation.
items.answer: Reflexive: a − a = 0 divisible by 2. Symmetric: a − b = 2m ⇒ b − a = 2(−m). Transitive: a − b = 2m, b − c = 2n ⇒ a − c = 2(m + n). Hence an equivalence relation.
items.markingKey: Reflexive (1), symmetric (1), transitive (1) with algebraic reason; conclusion.
